counting_policy: Six original WP-003 configurations and 41 evaluations (1+32+3+3+1+1), plus at most three WP-004 configurations and 12 evaluations. Cost profiles and random seeds are evaluation trials, not independent economic mechanisms. Numeric-only variants consume a separate counter whose current allowance is zero. Budgets reserve admissions, not only successful executions; failed/cancelled admissions never restore capacity. Extensions require a new explicit Research Director decision and immutable allocation record.
